name: NLPTEA 2017 Chinese Spelling Check shared task
description: This paper provides an overview along with our findings of the Chinese Spelling Check shared task at NLPTEA 2017. The goal of this task is to develop a computer-assisted system to automatically diagnose typing errors in traditional Chinese sentences written by students. We defined six types of errors which belong to two categories. Given a sentence, the system should detect where the errors are, and for each detected error determine its type and provide correction suggestions. We designed, constructed, and released a benchmark dataset for this task.
evaluation_method: F1 for detection; correction accuracy / precision for suggested corrections
reputation: Widely cited in Chinese spelling‑correction research and commonly used in academic shared‑task evaluations.
notes: Focused on student‑written traditional Chinese; limited size and genre bias; annotation granularity affects evaluation; not a large‑scale LLM benchmark.
